title: Filter scoped dashboard records before aggregation and verify rendered browser metrics
summary: Organization and personal work dashboards must reuse authenticated workspace scope and owner-tier visibility before computing counts, and browser verification must assert rendered labels and values.
reusable_steps: Organization and personal work dashboards must reuse authenticated workspace scope and owner-tier visibility before computing counts, and browser verification must assert rendered labels and values
expected_outcome: Resolve tenant, organization, project and information tier from the authenticated viewer on the server before counting records. A dashboard selection can only narrow that scope. Organization-wide views must reject project-limited viewers. Personal work must use the server-bound member ID and exact assignee_user_id match; never substitute role or principal labels. Client views must validate every consumed response field and withdraw stale rows on scope changes and failures. Build organization transitions from server-resolved parent selections so project-only URLs retain their authorized parents. Verify the compiled surface with actual Chromium and real authentication, API and approval-store paths inside a disposable product-policy-only synthetic root. Assert rendered metric names and values as well as API counts; token-key collisions and placeholder text can pass broad text assertions. Mobile checks must cover element bounds and document overflow. Always stop the owned server even when a browser close fails, await process exit, and only then remove fixture state.
